structural_cause: No knowledge capsule declares ownership of any docs/ path. All 20 capsule seeds were enumerated and none owns docs/evidence/. Company OS derives a work order scope from capsule ownership, so it cannot authorize a writable path it does not own, and therefore cannot run its reviewer chain over a document in docs/evidence/.
this_is_correct_behaviour: Yes. Refusing to derive a bounded scope for an unowned path is the intake behaviour the constitution requires; the benchmark should not have been able to widen its own authority.
